correctness.rationale: The formal-series proof reconstructs every quantifier. For \(R_j=B_j^p/B_{j+1}\), Freshman dream gives \(R_j\in1+p\mathbb Z[[x]]\); if \(U\in1+p\mathbb Z[[x]]\), then \(U^{p^r}\equiv1\pmod{p^{r+1}}\); exact telescoping yields modulus \(p^{a+1}\). At degree \(p^{a-1}\), the last ratio contributes \(-p^{a+1}\), earlier ratios are \(1\pmod{p^{a+2}}\), and division by \(A\) cannot cancel this residue. The finite verifier is supplementary and replays the claimed local valuations.
